review_scope: Main reviewer fully read all Chinese body paragraphs in this five-essay batch. Language reviewers separately read each complete assigned manuscript and Chinese source, repairing precise language issues while preserving every paragraph, argument, concrete example and limitation. Essay 16 paragraph 32 makes the proposed example consistent with the two daily needs established at its opening: full solitude and full shared time are allocated sequentially each day, not on alternating days. The surrounding possibility language and acknowledgement of genuine time/resource limits remain. All eight editions are synchronized. These are ethical/philosophical essays, not personalized legal or medical advice; no exhaustive external empirical audit is claimed.

before_by_language.zh: 一周中某几天保留完整独处，另几天保留完整共同时间。
before_by_language.hant: 一周中某幾天保留完整獨處，另幾天保留完整共同時間。
before_by_language.en: Preserve uninterrupted solitude on certain days of the week and uninterrupted time together on others.

edits.reason: 使方案真正同时满足开篇的两个每日需要，避免隔日轮换却声称两项需要均未改变的矛盾。
edits.zh: 每天先保留一段完整的独处，再安排一段不被打扰的共同时间；也可以按双方状态调整先后。
edits.hant: 每天先保留一段完整的獨處，再安排一段不被打擾的共同時間；也可以按雙方狀態調整先後。
edits.en: Each day, preserve a full period of solitude, then set aside an uninterrupted period together; the order can also change to suit how each person is doing.
